name: St Anne and St Brigid, Ancoats
note: Now part of a new parish of Holy Spirit (22.09.2017)

boundary.description: From the point where Rochdale Canal crosses the railway, near Lord North Street, along the railway to its crossing with Ten Acres Lane, then S along Ten Acres Lane, Bank Bridge Road and by River Medlock to the bridge. Then S along the footpath to and along Bank Street, Ashton New Road to and E along Ashton Canal, to Edge Lane. Then S along Edge Lane and W along Wheler Street and Ettrick Street to the end of the road and by a bee-line to Ashton Old Road, Lees Street to the railway. Then W along the railway through Gorton, Ashburys, Ardwick and Piccadily Stations. Then W along Fairfield Street, London Road, Piccadilly, Newton Street, Hilton Street, Stevenson Square, Hilton Street, Thomas Street, John Street, Turner Street, High Street, Shudehill, Swann Street, Oldham Road, Poland Street, to and E along Rochdale Canal to the point where it crosses the railway.
